This document details critical review and monitoring tasks for the IT & Digital department.

## Urgent Reviews:

*   Review the database migration urgently.
*   Update the API latency urgently.

## Standard and Quarterly Reviews/Monitoring:

*   Review the firewall settings standard update.
*   Review the encryption standards quarterly.
*   Monitor the firewall settings quarterly.
